_description: Universal VFX timing principles. Agent MUST reference these when setting lifetime, spawn rate, and curves.

core_rules.fast_in_slow_out: Most VFX effects appear quickly and fade slowly. Attack phase is 10-20% of total lifetime, sustain/decay is 80-90%.
core_rules.anticipation: Large effects benefit from a small anticipation cue 0.1-0.3s before the main burst (glow, spark, camera shake).
core_rules.overshoot: Scale/opacity can briefly exceed target value then settle. Creates energy and weight.
core_rules.secondary_motion: Main effect should trigger secondary effects with slight delay (0.05-0.15s). Explosion → debris → smoke → dust.

coreenergy.pulse_cycle: 0.4-1.2s for idle, 0.2-0.6s for charging or unstable states
coreenergy.spawn_pattern: continuous core + pulsed filament surges + optional accent bursts

dissolve.edge_glow_lead: appears 0.1-0.2s before dissolve reaches that area
dissolve.particle_emission: emits from dissolve edge during transition
dissolve.spawn_pattern: driven by dissolve threshold parameter, not time

opacity_over_life.fire: quick ramp up (0-10%), hold (10-60%), gradual fade (60-100%)
opacity_over_life.smoke: slow ramp up (0-20%), hold (20-50%), very slow fade (50-100%)
opacity_over_life.spark: instant full (0%), linear fade to zero
opacity_over_life.magic: ease-in to peak, sharp drop with slight tail

size_over_life.fire: start small, grow 1.5-2x, slight shrink at end
size_over_life.explosion: rapid expand 3-5x in first 20%, then slow growth

velocity_over_life.magic: can accelerate or follow custom curves
